correctness.rationale: For n≥6, every invariant independent set in Ind(C_n²) is a union of g-orbits, so the reduced signed Lefschetz trace is −I(B_g,−1) with the empty face and simplex orientation correctly counted. Rotations reduce to squared cycles of length gcd(n,a), or empty admissible orbit for d=1,2. A three-state transfer with characteristic x³−x²+1 gives recurrence W_d=W_{d−1}−W_{d−3}. Odd reflections yield a path square with one endpoint pendant, even reflections yield either a path with two pendants or a plain path square, giving stated A recurrences including n=6,7,8. Rational averaging after equivariant subdivision computes actual topological orbit quotient reduced Euler characteristic; χ is integer. The cubic characteristic polynomial has a negative real root of modulus <1 and conjugate pair modulus ρ>1. Infinitely many n have cos(nθ)≥1/2, so W_n dominates proper-divisor and reflection corrections O(n²ρ^{n/2}), proving absolute quotient Euler unbounded and infinitely many rationally non-acyclic quotients. Rebuilt orbit-subset sums for all dihedral elements n=6…18; every formula matched, finite corroboration only.
